lines: Karoge yaad to har baat yaad aayegi
couplets.en: If you look back, every little thing will come to mind.

lines: Guzarte waqt ki har mauj thahar jayegi
couplets.en: Every ripple of passing time will grow still.

lines: Ye chaand beete zamaanon ka aaina hoga
couplets.en: This moon will mirror the years gone by.

lines: Bhatakte abr mein chehra koi bana hoga
couplets.en: Some face will have taken shape in a wandering cloud.
The lonely road will tell a story.

lines: Barasta bheegta mausam dhuaan dhuaan hoga
couplets.en: The rain-soaked season will dissolve into haze.

lines: Pighalti shama pe dil ka mere gumaan hoga
couplets.en: The melting candle will put you in mind of my heart.

lines: Hatheliyon ki hina yaad kuchh dilayegi
couplets.en: The henna on your palms will stir a memory.

lines: Gali ke mod pe soona sa koi darwaaza
couplets.en: At the bend in the lane, a doorway stands forlorn.

lines: Tarasti aankhon se rasta kisi ka dekhega
couplets.en: With longing eyes, it will watch for someone to come.

lines: Nigaah door talak jaake laut aayegi
couplets.en: Your gaze will travel far before turning back.

lines: Karoge yaad to har baat yaad aayegi
couplets.en: If you look back, every little thing will come to mind.

couplets.en: Every ripple of passing time will grow still.
